ops.title: Fold ls-files and log --numstat into internal/gitcmd
ops.description:
`internal/kg/stale/gitscan.go` execs git directly for `ls-files -z` and `log --numstat -z`, because `internal/gitcmd` exposes neither and its `run` helper is unexported. The Phase 3 agent was told not to modify gitcmd, so it built a second exec path rather than widening one it had been fenced off from — the right call at the time, and a duplication to remove now.

One git exec path per repo is the invariant worth holding: gitcmd already owns credential handling, error wrapping and the `Dirs` contract, and a second caller drifts from all three.

Note the graph builder may add a third such need — `git log` with rename detection, for the path-rename edges that cc-notes note `cdc1cbb9` shows are the actual cause of the unmoved `staleness` eval category. Fold them together in one pass rather than one at a time.

ops.text: internal/kg/stale/gitscan.go execs no git directly; both commands go through internal/gitcmd
Any rename-detection log call the graph builder needs goes through the same path
